 Genoa host Milan at Marassi in the 11th round of Serie A , with kick-off at 3pm. Ruben Amorim's Milan arrive after beating Inter in the derby , but also after a heavy home defeat to Ferencvaros in the Europa League, while Daniele De Rossi's Genoa have won three consecutive league games . Milan sit fifth with 21 points, while Genoa are 12th with 13. Massa referees , with Camplone on VAR.
 Genoa-Milan 0-2 
 Scorers : 12' Cisse (M), 19' Pulisic (M)
 Goals and highlights
 19' - Marcandalli gives the ball away badly, and Ramos finds Pulisic, who slots it just inside the post 
 12' - Vásquez gives the ball away badly, Rabiot sets up Cisse and he side-foots home with his right foot for Milan 
 11' - After a good run, Gila plays the ball to Ramos, who challenges Marcandalli before the ball goes out for a goal kick
 6' - Ramos takes advantage of a poor clearance but strikes the ball badly with his right foot and sends it wide
 1' - Osmajić beats De Winter for pace, then sends a left-footed shot across goal just wide of the post to Maignan's left
 Official line-ups and match details
 Genoa (3-4-2-1) : Bijlow; Marcandalli, Østigård, Vásquez; Ehizibue, Traorè, Wiafe, Ellertsson; Messias, Vitinha; Osmajić. Substitutes: Sommariva, Stolz; Drameh, Mitaj, Otoa, Puczka, Sabelli; A. Amorim, Baldanzi, Meichtry, Sow; Colombo, El Shaarawy, Havel, Venturino. Manager: De Rossi.
 AC Milan (4-4-1-1) : Maignan; Gila, De Winter, Diawara, Musah; Moreira, Modrić, Rabiot, Cisse; Pulisic; Ramos. Substitutes: Bouyer, Torriani; Bartesaghi, Estupiñan, F. Terracciano, Vladimirov; Comotto, Hutchinson, Jashari; Camarda. Manager: R. Amorim.
 Referee : Massa
